examples.text: Ses branches terminales s’anastomosent avec l’artère buccale et l’artère infra-orbitaire.

glosses: To join (two or more things) by anastomosis, to interconnect forming a network.

examples.text: Happisburgh's humans discarded their stone tools close to one of several anastomosing, slow-flowing low-energy rivers, all of which meandered across a floodplain into a large estuary.
Within eukaryotic cells, distant branches of the tree of life entwine and melt into an inseparable new lineage; they fuse, or anastomose, as fungal hyphae do.

glosses: Joined or run together, ramified, interconnected.
